answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Thread. Each identity’s actions across epochs form a verifiable thread; a prism function samples prior epochs and rejects any identity whose behavioural distribution shifts beyond a fixed divergence bound, forcing attackers to sustain consistent behaviour per sockpuppet. Building that history across an orchard of identities costs continuous compute and real transaction fees for every epoch, a recurring per-identity cost that scales linearly with the number of fakes.
